name: Zhenshi Huanxiang
source:
Started with a sneak shot accident, the university campus which is supposed to be a place for education has been being involved in a series of cases. As a journalist, you will use your superpower to find out the truths behind the conspiracy, for justice and for your dream.
In order to collect news materials, you need to change your disguise by playing the dress-changing mini-game. With all the dangers ahead and the big responsibility on you, it is only your abilities and wisdom that can take you forward.
Could you become the light that breaks through the smog surrounding all the complicated cases one linked with another?
It’s all up to you.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/682470/]Steam[/url]]
